```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(googlesheets4)
library(usdata)
```

```{r}
#| label: read-data
incarceration <- read_csv(here::here("data/incarceration_trends_county.csv"))
hud_census_2019 <- read_csv(here::here("data/COUNTY_2019_2010census.csv"))
ca_econ_regions <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1lPrXvyP0_r4c1CKzU3Hv2SdJr7KCyjIv3zkJGLXBvNA/edit?usp=sharing")
county_complete <- usdata::county_complete |>
  mutate(fips = as.numeric(fips))
```

